name: postel
description: Find what's going viral in your niche, write your version in your own voice, and schedule it to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon through your Postel account.

interface.shortDescription: Viral post research, writing in your voice, and scheduling to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon
interface.longDescription: Postel's hosted MCP server finds posts that went viral in your niche, writes your version in your own voice, and schedules or publishes it to X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon after you approve. Research works without an account; run /mcp-config login postel to sign in for drafting and scheduling. Includes the postel-writing skill.
